Container.Name: KidsStar
Container.Overview:
KidsStar for Yuvomi: children earn stars for everyday actions and redeem them in a star shop; includes a "Who are you?" hallway tablet mode.
This container stores the stars (SQLite + pictures in /data). Either open Yuvomi through this container's port (it passes everything else to Yuvomi unchanged), or - if Yuvomi already sits behind a reverse proxy such as Nginx Proxy Manager - set PROXY_YUVOMI=false and route only /api/extensions/kidsstar/ here.
Also install the KidsStar module into Yuvomi (Settings - Modules - Add custom module: FlessingLabs/yuvomi-kidsstar, or copy the module folder). Guide: https://github.com/FlessingLabs/yuvomi-kidsstar

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port of the KidsStar service. Without your own reverse proxy: open Yuvomi through this port.

Config.Name: Yuvomi URL
Config.Description: Address of your Yuvomi container as seen from here: your Unraid IP and Yuvomi's port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stars, actions, rewards and pictures. Include it in your backups.

Config.Name: Pass other paths to Yuvomi
Config.Description: true = this container is the entrance to Yuvomi. false = you route /api/extensions/kidsstar/ here from your own reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Yuvomi API token (hallway tablet)
Config.Description: Optional. Needed only for the hallway tablet: create it in Yuvomi under Settings - Household - API access with exactly the scopes ext:kidsstar:read and family:read.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Fallback time zone until a parent has opened KidsStar once (then Yuvomi's household time zone is used).

Config.Name: PUBLIC_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Optional. Fixed public address(es), comma-separated, e.g. https://yuvomi.example.org. Empty = the address the browser used.
